cards.card_text: The writer says such a high priest truly befits us: holy, innocent, undefiled, set apart from sinners, and exalted above the heavens.
cards.verse_text: Such a high priest truly befits us—One who is holy, innocent, undefiled, set apart from sinners, and exalted above the heavens.
cards.snippet: Such a high priest truly befits us—One who is holy, innocent, undefiled, set apart from sinners, and exalted above the heavens.

cards.card_text: Then James shows what religion that's pure and undefiled before our God and Father looks like.
cards.verse_text: Pure and undefiled religion before our God and Father is this: to care for orphans and widows in their distress, and to keep oneself from being polluted by the world.
cards.snippet: Pure and undefiled religion before our God and Father is this: to care for orphans…

cards.card_text: Peter says that inheritance is imperishable, undefiled and unfading, reserved in heaven for them.
cards.verse_text: and into an inheritance that is imperishable, undefiled, and unfading, reserved in heaven for you,
cards.snippet: and into an inheritance that is imperishable, undefiled, and unfading, reserved in heaven for you,
